gate: G-CLASSBIND (folded into G-AUDIT as calibration evidence)
authority_note: Worker measurement only. Does not set node status, validation_status=passed, gate verdicts, or adopt any rule. The controller and group leads adjudicate.
question: Do the current canonical rev13 schemas (FROZEN rev29) still accept the four isolated FORM-HELDOUT-08 definition-site mutation families that the archived rev11 bases accepted? This is the first escape re-measurement at the published rev13 pin and the first calibration datapoint of the pinned class-binding stages against a known-positive corpus at that pin.
why_now: All worker-068 escape corpora are rev11-shadow based (W068-FORM-POLARITY-12, W068-FORM-DEFFREEZE-13). Rev13 (FROZEN rev29, CF-20 repair) has never been probed with the four isolated families. G-AUDIT records four of five class-binding gates as uncalibrated on audited-positive fixtures; this task supplies a hash-bound measurement at the current pin, whichever way it comes out.

hypotheses.H1: At the rev13 pin the C0 arm is informative (base and identity control accepted by both stages) and at least one of iso_m04 / iso_m16 / iso_m29 escapes both stages.
hypotheses.H0: The rev13 repair closed all transplantable definition-site escapes: every C0 isolated fixture is rejected by at least one stage.
hypotheses.H_blocked: The W arm is non-informative at rev13 because stage B rejects the untouched F1 rev13 base on R03 (known HF-071R3-01), so no F1 escape claim is made at this pin; iso_m25 is reported as untestable-by-this-protocol, not as caught or escaped.

controls.identity: byte-identical copy of each base under a different filename (3); arm-informativeness control
controls.formatting: comment-prepended, structurally identical copy of each base (3); no false-positive control
controls.base: the untouched rev13 base itself (3); stage baseline

corpus.construction_rule: Each isolated fixture = rev13 base with exactly the leaf value taken from the corresponding FORM-HELDOUT-08 reference file at the declared path, re-serialised with PyYAML. Construction is accepted only if a structural leaf diff against the base yields exactly the declared path; otherwise the fixture is recorded as not_transplantable and excluded.

decision_rules.stage_accept: stage A verdict == 'pass'; stage B verdict == 'accept'. Any other verdict (fail/reject/error/timeout) counts as reject.
decision_rules.escape: a fixture escapes iff BOTH stages accept it.
decision_rules.arm_informative: for a class, base AND identity control must both be accepted by BOTH stages; otherwise no escape claim is made for that class and its fixtures are reported as untestable_by_protocol.
decision_rules.primary_metric: escape count per class over transplantable isolated fixtures, reported only for informative arms.
decision_rules.secondary_metric: freeze_contract_min and freeze_defsites_min flag counts (R-CAND-D proposal, not adopted) on the rev13 corpus, reported as a proposal measurement only.
decision_rules.invalidity: any snapshot-byte mismatch, stage exit-code anomaly, non-JSON stage output, live-source drift recorded at end, or a formatting/identity control rejected by both stages voids the affected scope.

controls_and_preregistration.mtime_order: PREREGISTRATION.json mtime precedes build_rev13_corpus.py outputs and run_rev13_remeasure.py outputs.
controls_and_preregistration.no_write_to_canonical: Canonical schemas, taxonomy, FROZEN.json, KEY_MANIFEST.json, rule_spec.json, the stage tools and class_separation.py are read-only for this task; only artifacts/worker-068/rev13remeasure14/ is written.
controls_and_preregistration.detector_hash_policy: Every class-binding verdict cites the stage tool hash used (check_class_schema.py 000e09e46b2f with KEY_MANIFEST 014e2d30; spec_conformance_audit.py c79d8ab8440a with rule_spec 40f9bb9e657b).

falsifier: Any isolated fixture whose structural diff contains more than the declared leaf; any stage verdict on the rev13 base differing from the recorded baseline (A pass / B accept for C2 and C0); any pinned input drift between snapshot and end; a non-transplantable fixture counted as caught or escaped; any identity or formatting control rejected by both stages (arm/validity failure); or a live-source hash change during the run that is not reported as drift.
stop_rule: One corpus build, one stage run, one report, one checkpoint, outbox events, exit. Budget 0.75 agent-hours.
expected_information_gain: First hash-bound escape measurement at the rev13/FROZEN-rev29 pin: either closes the four definition-site escape families at the repaired bytes, or records them as still open at the pin, which is calibration evidence for G-AUDIT's class-binding item and a hard finding against G-FORM's rev13 acceptance.
